comments.author: pudquick
comments.text: data: URI URLs aren't supported in it, it has nothing to do with the size / length of the QR code For example, this self-contained webpage: <html><body>Hi!</body></html> encoded is: data:text/html;base64,PGh0bWw+PGJvZHk+SGkhPC9ib2R5PjwvaHRtbD4= If you paste that into a browser, it will render "Hi!". Very short and easy. But if you encode is as a QR code, it won't work in this situation.
